title: Duck Rillettes Naan Bites
description: A twist on traditional Indian street food, these bite-sized naan bites are filled with rich and creamy duck rillettes.
instructions: Slice the French baguette into 1-inch pieces.
In a bowl, mix together the duck rillettes and kissed butter until well combined.
Add the spicy mango chutney to the duck rillettes mixture and mix until smooth.
Spoon a small amount of the duck rillettes mixture onto each baguette piece.
Top each baguette piece with a sprinkle of salt and a few leaves of fresh cilantro.
Bake the naan bites in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
